newsitem.title: CHINA: HK may launch property clampdown measures- Tung.
newsitem.headline: HK may launch property clampdown measures- Tung.

text.p: Hong Kong's new leader Tung Chee-hwa said on Tuesday the government will launch measures to curb speculation in the property sector when necessary, and the housing problems can be solved with determination.

"The crux of the housing problems is that demand exceeds supply, which leads to leaps in property prices and gives chances to speculators," Tung said in a speech at the inauguration of the Hong Kong government under Chinese rule. "In fact, Hong Kong has enough land. As long as we are determined, we must be able to solve completely the housing problems in Hong Kong," he said.

"We will draw up a 10-year housing development plan, including the acceleration of reclamation from the sea, development projects, and large-scale development of collective transport systems and infrastructure designs," he said.
